token.title: 🔑 Ithokheni ye-GitHub
token.intro: I-GitHub iphendula izicelo ezingu-60 ngehora kukheli elingathumeli thokheni. Isihlahla sama-fork esipheleleyo sidla okungaba ngu-32, ngakho ekuvakasheleni kwesibili ziyaphela. Ithokheni ikhuphula umkhawulo ube ngu-5000 ngehora.
token.step1: Vula Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, bese ukhetha Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: i-akhawunti yakho. Expiration: loba yiluphi usuku, isihlahla kasidingi lutho oluhlala isikhathi eside.
token.step4: Ungathinti loba yiyiphi imvume. Imininingwane yamaqoqo omphakathi kayidingi lanye kuzo.
token.step5: Yidale, bese ukopisha inani le-{token}. I-GitHub ilitshengisa kanye kuphela.
token.classic: Ithokheni yakudala layo iyasebenza: dala eyodwa ungakhethanga loba yimuphi umkhawulo. Umkhawulo ongelalutho ulokhu ufunda idatha yomphakathi ngezinga eliqinisekisiweyo.
token.stays: Ihlala kule bhrawuza ngaphansi kukakhiye {key} njalo iya ku-{host} kuphela. Kayibhalwa ebhodini lekheli, ngakho ilinki oyabelanayo iphatha umbono hatshi imininingwane yokungena. Inkinobho engaphansi kwenkundla iyayisula futhi kanye le-cache.
token.persistHow: Faka ithokheni efayilini le-{env} leseva ephethe leli khasi, eceleni kuka-{port}:
token.proxy: bese uyiqalisa nge-{make}. Isitsha sesibhala isiqeshana se-nginx esinamathisela i-header ye-{header} ku-proxy ye-{path}, ngakho ibhrawuza ibiza umsuka wayo njalo kayikaze ithole ithokheni. Le nkundla iyanyamalala, bonke abavakatshi babelane ngesabelo esisodwa sika-5000 ngehora.
fork.refused404: Kakukho migqa yamagatsha: {message}. I-404 lapha yigatsha elingekho kumbe indlela i-proxy yeseva engayidluliseli; inethiwekhi yama-fork ngenhla iphelele loba kunjani.
fork.refusedExhausted: I-GitHub iphelelwe yizicelo zaleli hora, ngakho imigqa yamagatsha kayibanga lakho ukudwetshwa. Inethiwekhi yama-fork ngenhla iphelele. Engeza ithokheni kuphaneli yesihluzi, kumbe ucime imigqa yamagatsha kuphaneli yokubukeka ukuze usebenzise isabelo kunethiwekhi kuphela.
fork.refusedOther: I-GitHub iphendule ngo-{status} emlandweni wama-commit, ngakho imigqa yamagatsha kayibanga lakho ukudwetshwa. Inethiwekhi yama-fork ngenhla iphelele.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Ithegi kalalo usuku, ngakho ngalinye kwasele belizadinga isicelo, kodwa isabelo esisele sehora kasisetshenziswa kulokho.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, ifasitela lama-commit lamathegi alayishiweyo. Imigqa yama-fork emidala kulalo ibekwa emphethweni wesobunxele.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Vula iqoqo ukuze udwebe imizila yalo yama-commit lokuhlanganiswa; ngemva kwalokho i-eksisi incipha iye kulowo mlando.

bond.title: Imatrikisi yezibopho
bond.help: Umugqa uye kukholamu ngenhla, ikholamu iye emugqeni ngezansi. Isibopho esingu-0 likhasi, u-1 ngokuphambene kwalo. Ukudlula ngekhesa kuphambanisa ipheya ngophuzi, ukuchofoza kuyalibamba ngokunsomi kuze kube yikuchofoza okulandelayo. Ukufunda kuphela; qalisa i-CLI ye-infinito bond ukuze uhlele.

tests.status.skipped: isango le-skip livaliwe lapha; isivivinyo siyasebenza kolunye uhlobo
tests.status.always: kakukho hlobo olunquma leli sango, ngakho isivivinyo kasiqinisekanga
tests.status.unknown: lolu hlobo lutshiya isango livulekile; olunye luyalinquma
tests.note.noSort: Kakukho INFINITO_DISCOVERY_SORT: faka i-default.env ye-checkout ye-core (INFINITO_ENV_FILE) ukuze uhlele ngokulandelana kokufaka.

tests.note.ciSort.one: Ukulandelana kwe-CI kuthathwe lapha emugqeni otholakeleyo ongu-{n}, nge-INFINITO_DISCOVERY_SORT. Nxa kulingana kusetshenziswa ibizo lendima: ukhiye wokucina walokho kucaciswa yi-nonce edonswa yi-core ekuqhutshweni ngakunye, engelakuphindwa yilutho.
